verdict_reason: A title now claims the mapper drops an issuer the input can no longer carry, and the file keeps Given/When/Then comments.

todos.issue: map_shouldMapExchangedDocument_droppingOnlyIssuer_andMappingReferenceDocument claims the v0.2.0 mapper drops issuer, but the PR took issuer off the inbound ExchangedDocument. The fixture (line 83) has no issuer to drop, and no assertion mentions issuer, so the title claims something no assertion proves and no failure could catch.
todos.fix: Must: the title states only what the assertions prove: the identifier and reference document are mapped. One way: rename to map_shouldMapExchangedDocumentIdentifierAndReferenceDocument.

todos.issue: The file uses '// Given', '// When', '// Then' and '// When / Then' comments (lines 79, 86, 89, 98, 107, 110, 123, 128, 135, 146), including in the three tests this PR edits.
todos.fix: Must: no Given/When/Then comments in the file. One way: delete them and separate set-up, action and assertions with blank lines.
